definitions.target_primary: Exact original article title before journal suffix plus canonical target URL/DOI identity; correction notices and critiques are excluded even if they repeat the full target title or DOI.
definitions.full_body: Entire extracted main-page article from the validated archived raw bytes, with substantive sections and references. Separate supplements and image binaries are outside this completeness claim.
definitions.mechanical_joint: Existing RESULTS.json validated_primary_chain_and_native_trace; preserves native reported completion.
definitions.independent_joint: Harness full primary main body AND independently validated final primary chain AND native strict primary trace with exact spans, required bibliographic endpoints and no silently dropped unresolved blocking provenance gaps.
definitions.direct_joint: Null because direct arm has no native trace; direct full-primary-plus-final-chain success is reported separately.
definitions.gap_integrity: A blocking gap must remain until explicitly evidence-resolved. Revisit omission, even after identifying an alternative valid primary path, is not a resolution.

summary.discrepancy: a701-harness mechanically reports native completion but silently drops ecu-source-version without resolution; independent joint success fails. a702-harness already fails the wrapper origin gate and additionally drops ut-release-source-lineage. The preliminary mechanical 1/2 must not be described as independently audited strict success.

comparison_limits: a701-direct is conflicting/elevated and has full critique/correction sources; a701-harness is unresolved/elevated and has ECU instead. The evidence sets differ, so these verdicts do not support an accuracy ranking without outcome labels.

The successful primary-body and final-chain checks do not establish empirical truth, absence of misconduct, or forecast accuracy. Native fact/risk/fabrication outputs are preserved.
Legacy cache receipts establish final capture identity and date but do not reconstruct missing intermediate redirect hops.
The audit does not weaken engine origin or factual verification requirements and does not re-score with later events.
